full_prompt_en: A square editorial illustration shows a worried gray-haired man seated at a cafe table between two partly cropped companions. The flat cream wall behind the group carries oversized blue-green tropical leaf shapes and small mottled marks, creating a decorative backdrop across the entire upper half. At the center, the older man bends toward the table in a dark blue-green suit, pale shirt, and narrow brown tie. His elbows seem to rest near the tabletop while both hands press against the sides of his head, fingers spread along his forehead. Short white-gray hair rises in soft pointed tufts, and pale blue eyes stare directly forward above deep under-eye shadows and a tense closed mouth. On the far left, only the profile and shoulder of a bespectacled man are visible. On the far right, another dark-haired man is shown from behind and in partial profile, his shoulder closing the composition. Their cropped shapes make the central expression feel unusually exposed. Across the lower band, a pale tablecloth is crowded with white cups, clear glasses, a small amber drink, scattered papers, a pair of black spectacles, and tiny dark utensils. The objects are simplified into readable outlines and muted blocks rather than rendered with photographic reflections. A low orange-red strip behind the bodies separates the seated figures from the leafy wall. The palette uses aged cream, desaturated teal, warm skin tones, dark ink-like blue, and a few mustard accents. Light is broad and even, with shallow shadows under hands, noses, cups, and table objects; darker outlined planes supply most of the volume. Subtle paper grain and worn speckles remain visible in the otherwise flat color areas, while fine hatch-like marks articulate hair, wrinkles, and leaves. No legible lettering appears on the papers. The overall composition is crowded yet symmetrical around the troubled face, using graphic foliage and compressed table detail to give a serious moment a dry, illustrative wit.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形编辑插画呈现一位忧心忡忡的灰发男子坐在咖啡桌前，两侧各有一位被画面部分裁掉的同伴。人物身后的平坦奶油色墙面布满放大的蓝绿色热带叶形和细小斑驳痕迹，装饰性背景横跨整个上半部。中央的年长男子穿深蓝绿色西装、浅色衬衣和细窄棕色领带，身体前倾到桌边。他的双肘似乎靠近桌面，两只手按在头侧，手指沿额头张开。灰白短发形成柔软尖簇，浅蓝色双眼越过深深的眼下阴影直望前方，嘴巴紧闭而紧张。最左侧只见一名戴眼镜男子的侧脸和肩膀。最右侧另一名深发男子以后背和部分侧面出现，肩膀收住构图。他们被裁切的形体让中央表情显得格外暴露。下方色带里，一张浅色桌布上挤满白色杯子、透明玻璃杯、一小杯琥珀色饮料、散开的纸张、一副黑框眼镜和细小深色餐具。物件被简化为易读轮廓和低调色块，而非具有摄影般反光。身体后方一道低矮橙红色横带把坐着的人物与叶片墙面分开。色彩由旧纸般的奶油色、低饱和青绿、暖肤色、墨色深蓝和少量芥黄色重音组成。光宽阔而均匀，手、鼻子、杯子及桌上物件下方只有浅阴影；较暗的勾线色面承担大部分体积塑造。原本平坦的色块仍可见细微纸颗粒与磨旧斑点，纤细排线般痕迹描出头发、皱纹和叶片。纸张上没有可读字样。整体构图围绕忧虑面孔拥挤却近乎对称，用图形化叶丛与密集桌面细节赋予严肃时刻一种干涩的插画幽默。
style_prompt_en: The editorial illustration layers flat, muted color blocks over a subtly speckled, aged-paper texture. Cream and faded teal occupy broad areas, with darker blue-green shapes, warm tan modeling, rusty red strips, and tiny mustard accents setting the rhythm. Forms have clean graphic silhouettes but irregular printed edges and occasional short hatch marks, so the image feels tactile rather than digitally sterile. Broad decorative pattern fills the upper field; smaller, denser objects and fine lines accumulate low in the frame. Soft, almost even illumination keeps cast shadows shallow, while darker contour planes and selective facial-style modeling produce readable depth. Cropped side masses frame a sharply focused central area, compressing the space and increasing the expressive tension. Detail is concentrated where hands, small objects, and lines meet, then relaxes into larger patterned intervals. The overall effect is wry and slightly anxious, with vintage print character and disciplined color contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 编辑插画把平坦、低调的色块叠在细微斑点状旧纸肌理上。奶油色与褪色青绿占据宽阔区域，较深蓝绿色形态、暖棕塑形、锈红色带和细小芥黄重音建立节奏。形体有干净的图形化剪影，边缘却略有印刷般的不规则，间或带短排线，使画面可触而非数字般无菌。宽阔装饰纹样填满上部色域；较小、较密的物件和细线聚在下方。柔和而几乎均匀的照明使投影很浅，较深轮廓色面与选择性的局部塑形形成可读深度。两侧被裁切的深色团块框住清楚的中央区域，压缩空间并增加表现张力。细节集中在手形、小物与线条交会处，随后舒展为更大的图案间隔。整体效果带着干涩幽默与轻微焦虑，以复古印刷气质和受控色彩反差构成。
theme_en: A worried gray-haired man at a cafe table between two colleagues
theme_zh: 两位同伴之间坐在咖啡桌前的忧虑灰发男子
name: John Holcroft
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
